rule.tier: census tier LOCO-ONLY of the QUAD press closure (ff9mapkit.eb.pressclosure == studies/field-coop/guest-traversal/interaction_census.py): player locomotion only -- no window, choice, exit, battle, menu, persistent write, latch, spawn, tile or SPS op anywhere in the closure
rule.kinds: ladder-navigable and ladder-auto -> ladder (1), jump -> jump (2), carry-loop -> carry (3); a candidate of any other mover kind (walk, teleport) is a generator error
rule.slice: start = 2 + fpos of the FIRST func-table row whose tag matches (EventEngine.GetIP); end = the next body in (fpos, table index) order -- a tie goes to the later-listed row -- never past the entry (ff9mapkit eb/model.py); a start past the entry has length 0; a table that does not fit its entry, or no matching tag, is absent
rule.crc: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC: zlib.crc32 == Unity.IO.Compression.Crc32Helper.UpdateCrc32(0u, buf, off, len); a function matches only when its length agrees first and then its CRC
rule.uid: the DISPATCH uid: ctrl 250 (RunScript* through the control uid: the control character's own function), fixed_ctrl its fixed uid (1..249, naming DefinePlayerCharacter entries), region and seq 0
rule.func_order: the region function (the row's entry, tag 3) first, then the rest by (role, entry, tag) ascending, each triple once per row
rule.refusals: R1 closure (truncated, decode failure, unresolved or computed uid/tag); R2 edge (self, party, sender, spawn, fixed_other); R3 roles (one function in two roles); R4 table (not strictly increasing, an fpos past the entry, a duplicated closure tag); R5 card (a tag-8 handler on the region); R6 seq (a RunSharedScript target that is not exactly one tag-0 function); R7 body (none, ctrl and fixed_ctrl mixed, two fixed uids); R8 short (a function under 8 bytes); R9 language (a language missing or different); R10 is a generator error (the C# slice twin disagrees with the kit model); R11 latch (any function outside the closure reads a MAP/instance var the closure writes on some CFG path before a plain B_LET covers it -- compound *_LET, ++/-- and an RHS self-read are reads, a write covers only its own bits -- exempt only when it is a tag-0/1 load-once reader: no RunScript*/RunScriptObject*/Seq targets it, no ReturnEntryFunctions can restart it (tag 1), its every uncovered read precedes its first backward-jump target, and its entry is created only by entry 0's tag-0 Init*); R12 op (a closure function holds ReturnEntryFunctions, or a TerminateEntry that is not the constant self-end 255); R13 write (the closure writes a Global or Null var: it may write only Map and Instance vars)
